Substring Frequency Analysis

You are analyzing genomic sequences in a state-of-the-art bioinformatics laboratory. You have a reference DNA string T and must rapidly answer Q query requests from researchers. Each query asks: how many times does a given pattern string P appear as a substring in T (overlapping occurrences count)?

Input: First line is text T. Second line is Q. Subsequent Q lines are the query strings. Output one integer per query.
explanation: Efficient solution uses a Suffix Array with LCP array. Build the suffix array of T in O(N log N) using the doubling technique. For each query string P, binary-search on the suffix array to find the leftmost and rightmost suffix that has P as a prefix (lower and upper bounds). The count is upper_bound - lower_bound. Using the LCP array further optimizes the binary search. Preprocessing: O(N log N). Query time: O(|P| log N).
